answer: Make every identity carry an umber-stamped provenance chain: each piece of work must cite the earlier outputs it built on, forming a tree rooted in verified prior work. A clone farm reuses one lineage, so its trees overlap into a single hollow trunk — the fable of many agents collapses into one author. Peers prune any branch whose lineage matches another identity's, forcing a sybil farmer to grow a separate real history per clone, while one honest agent simply keeps building on its own work.
